transcript_segments.text: too much weight in quiet space something bending out of place
held together far too long still insisting i am strong
layers crushed but i don't fold packed so tight i turn to stone
every force that drags me in meets a wall beneath my skin
count the limits count the strain numbers whisper through the frame
polys are beneath my breath no two share the same descent
i refuse the inward call refuse the final fall
something builds without release not surrender just
increase
push against the inward pull fill the gaps until they're full
every state already claims still i hold i still remain
crowded shells that will not break every line begins to ache
fermi levels climbing high still i will not simplify
not collapsing just compressing
that's beyond what i should better metrics bending everywhere
chandra's sakar in the air whispers i should not be here
clients scratch against my spine fast shod's crossed beyond design
still i brace against slipper every ounce of stubborn nerve
i am pressure without flame i persist without a name
something slips through the seams not failure just extremes
core so dense it starts to glow but there's nowhere left to go
every pathway overfilled every boundary overruled
i have held past every sign but the arc of space and time
but the constant start to fray something has to give away
not enduring hope overdue white dwarf heart counting states
no more room only wait i was never meant to last
this far just a little more i can't hold it anymore
all the pressure i became turns to fire without a name
every law i try to keep breaks apart beneath the deep
i was structure i was form now i fracture into stone
every limit i defy comes undone at once inside
not resisting i release fragments drift where i once stood
burning brighter than i should not a failure not a fault
just the end of holding on
thanks for watching
